title: Monday · belonging, place value & new beginnings
arrival: Unpack and settle in. Today: belonging, place value, Truth and Reconciliation booklets, and choosing our novel.
note: Planned Monday, September 21; not completed. PE/LST unconfirmed. Prepare forms, booklets, math materials, reviewed Indigenous-created source and novel previews; no devices needed. Full notes: docs/MONDAY_2026-09-21.md. Add actual timing after teaching; keep student details private.

blocks.title: Welcome & settle in
studentSteps: Unpack; have a pencil ready. Read, colour or continue Discovery work.

blocks.title: Attendance, forms & Discovery check-in
blocks.notes: Attendance first; then forms in separate trays. Track returns privately. Check Discovery: submitted, still working, or needs help. Offer replacements. Afternoon catch-up.
studentSteps: Attendance first; then hand in information forms and device agreements.
Submit your finished Discovery booklet, or show where you are at.
Ask quietly for help or replacements.

blocks.title: Everyone belongs · PE & outdoor activities
blocks.notes: Begin: I asked everyone to play on gravel without checking the activity worked for everyone. I am sorry. It is my responsibility to plan for everyone to participate. Discuss barriers; agree on changes. Allow private suggestions, no personal disclosures. Inclusion is not a vote; sideline roles must be a choice. NVC/Agreements later.
studentSteps: What makes a game hard to join: space, surface, rules, equipment, pace, or how people act?
What could we change so everyone can take part? Try moving a marker or changing the shared playing area.
Speak, write or share privately. Choose changes to try; check whether they help.

blocks.title: Movement break & math setup
studentSteps: Choose a comfortable seated or standing stretch. Get math materials ready.

blocks.title: Math · whole-number place value
blocks.notes: 60 minutes: model 10, optional video 10, guided work 15, practice 20, check 5. Math Antics: https://mathantics.com/lesson/place-value. No-video model below. Answers: 6,000 + 300 + 7; zero tens; 8,642 / 2,468; exit 6,000 / 600. Adjust support; decimals later.
studentSteps: Use thousands, hundreds, tens and ones columns. Model: 4,582 = 4,000 + 500 + 80 + 2. The 5 means 500.
Each place to the left is worth ten times as much. Show ten ones making one ten.
Partners: represent 6,307. Explain the zero. Practise with the teacher’s whole numbers.
Challenge: use 2, 4, 6 and 8 once each to make the greatest and smallest four-digit numbers.
Exit: what is the value of 6 in 6,042? In 2,615?

blocks.title: Truth and Reconciliation · begin our booklets
blocks.notes: Prepare intended booklet pages and reviewed Indigenous-created source; not attached. Introduce 10 min, read 15, model 10, work 20, reflect 5. Include everyone regardless of Discovery progress. Offer oral/drawn/scribed responses. No personal disclosures or residential-school simulations.
studentSteps: Learn whose account or work we are using. Read or watch together; ask about unfamiliar words.
Watch the first booklet activity modelled, then begin the selected pages. Ask for support.
Share one thing learned or a question. No private family experiences are required.

blocks.title: Quiet reading, drawing or colouring
studentSteps: Read, draw or colour quietly. Give others space; put materials away at the signal.

blocks.title: Choose our class novel
blocks.notes: Prepare equal brief previews of the selected editions; not attached. Collect private rankings/reasons; confirm an available suitable book. Defer final choice if previews are incomplete.
studentSteps: Preview Bloom, Dragonborn and Nevermoor. Notice setting, characters and adventure.
Explain what makes you curious. Privately rank the three choices and give a reason.
We will collect preferences and choose an available story.

blocks.title: Discovery booklets · finish & submit
blocks.notes: Use the morning check-in to target support. Collect privately; read/colour when finished. Check remaining booklet sorting.
studentSteps: Finish a Discovery page; add useful details and ask for help.
Check name/division, then submit. Finished? Read or colour.

blocks.title: Class activity or classroom care
blocks.notes: Accessible cooperative activity OR classroom care. Apply morning inclusion changes; no automatic Capture the Flag. Check access, rules and stop signal. Captains help with care. Return equipment by 2:20.
studentSteps: Try a short activity everyone can join, or care for our classroom.
For games, check rules and stop signal; use our inclusion changes. For care, tidy and return materials; captains help.
Return equipment by 2:20.

blocks.title: Planners, final jobs & pack-up
blocks.notes: Help record reminders. Complete jobs, pack and dismiss at 2:35.
studentSteps: Planner: Photo Day tomorrow, Tuesday September 22. Return outstanding information forms and device agreements.
Finish jobs and pack belongings. Dismissal 2:35.

backups: Later: NVC and Five Agreements each need 60 minutes, tentatively Tuesday/Wednesday around confirmed commitments. Decimals follow whole-number checks.
If early: extend math, use a conversation card, read, colour or try a partner puzzle. Carry unfinished work forward.
Check remaining supplies/booklet sorting. Werewolf can wait; revisit hidden-information rules before playing.
